brief:
A joint report by Oxfam and the Conflict and Environment Observatory, titled "Environmental War Crimes," concludes that Israeli military operations in Gaza have transformed the territory into a "toxic wasteland," according to Middle East Eye. The report frames the environmental degradation as connected to what it characterizes as genocide in the Gaza Strip.

The findings document severe environmental damage from the conflict, though specific details of the report's methodology and evidence were not provided in the available summary.
dek: Israel has turned Gaza into a 'toxic wasteland' A new report, “Environmental War Crimes”, by Oxfam and the Conflict and Environment Observatory finds that Israel’s genocide in the Gaza Strip has turned it into a “toxic wasteland”.
title: Oxfam report accuses Israel of turning Gaza into toxic wasteland
